_about: Phoenix 'The Clue That Vanished': the four cases. One source of truth: the game inlines this file at build time and tools/verify_phoenix_cases.py checks it. Picture is 160 x 100; the trench floor is the rectangle TRENCH (x, y, w, h), split into cols x rows squares. Square codes: s = 1 layer of soil, S = 2 layers, i = 1 layer then the icy layer, I = 1 layer then HARD ice (needs the rasp), J = 2 layers then hard ice, # = a rock (not dug). Chunks sit only on icy squares; fate gone = vanished by Sol 24, stays = still there. Only case 1 is modelled on a real trench (Dodo-Goldilocks); cases 2-4 are made-up game cases.
